messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — noticed a weird 'timewarp' on the latency dashboard for /generate today. p50 dropped ~120ms at 09:12 but upstream traffic and throughput didn't change.
Samir Khan: saw that. endpoint breakdown shows p50 down, p95/p99 unchanged — so tail still there.
Devon Lee: Could be a sampling window issue when we merge endpoint rollups across regions. Did anyone change rollup policy or sampler?
Eli Turner: No config change on sampler. Routing policy had a small canary that pinched traffic to eu-west for 10m. Might that create an odd cohort with lower latency?
Rachel Gomez: Canary was tiny (<1% traffic). The drop looks global on the dashboard, not per-region.
Maya Patel: Screenshot: "metrics:latency | endpoint=/generate | rollup=hourly" — p50 line dips at 09:12 while raw request rate steady. Could be merge ordering or stale cached bucket.
Samir Khan: paste of quick query I ran:
```
SELECT percentile(tdigest_merge(tdigest), 0.5) AS p50
FROM metrics
WHERE endpoint='/generate' AND ts >= '2026-03-20T09:00:00Z'
GROUP BY region
```
One region shows a very low tdigest count that biases the merge.
Devon Lee: That suggests merge weighting problem. If one tdigest has near-zero count but extreme low values, merge might pull the centroid and skew combined percentile. We saw similar with compressed histograms before.
Eli Turner: deploy-bot: new telemetry push: "tdigest-merge: missing-sample-counts detected" — anyone correlate?
deploy-bot: noticed nonzero merges where sample_count == 0 for a few shards (gc race).
Rachel Gomez: ah — shards with sample_count 0 but non-empty centroids would indeed pull median down. We should treat sample_count==0 as empty and ignore during merge.
Maya Patel: Agreed. Quick fixes: 1) dashboard: display per-percentile sample_origin hover (region/shard) so we can see which shard contributed most; 2) runtime: ignore tdigest entries with sample_count==0 during merge.
Samir Khan: also propose a small UI change: add a toggle to show 'raw sample counts' next to p50/p95/p99 lines to avoid misleading visual timewarps.
Devon Lee: I'll open a runtime PR for the tdigest merge guard. Eli can you file a dashboard UX ticket?
Eli Turner: on it — creating ticket RD-INF-8492 with proposed hover and raw-count toggle. Adding screenshots and reproduction steps.
Rachel Gomez: for postmortem: note shorthand — "timewarp" = percentile dip due to zero-count tdigest shards. Recommend adding an alert if aggregated p50 shifts >20% without matching rate change.
Maya Patel: thanks. temporary dashboard note pinned to the panel until fix is deployed.
Samir Khan: timeline — Devon PR + tests today, deploy tomorrow morning. Then UX patch and dashboard tweak next week.
Devon Lee: PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523
Eli Turner: ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RD-INF-8492 (assigning Rachel as reviewer)
Maya Patel: 👍 good plan. I'll watch the panel and mute alerts for the test window.
